A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''Chiss''' worked as a [[Security officer/Legends|security officer]] in [[Kaas City]] for the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].<ref name="TOR" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Chiss security officer first appeared in the [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released on [[December 20]], [[2011]].<ref name="TOR" />
